labels.note: Without ^ anchor, domains like 'x; Secure=a.com' pass validation, enabling Set-Cookie attribute injection.
Leading-dot domains like '.example.com' rejected; a leading ';' or other char accepted, allowing injection.
First label must be 2+ chars; single-char first labels like 'a.com' wrongly rejected.
Requires exactly two labels; 'localhost' and 'sub.example.com' rejected, both common inputs.
Subsequent labels must be 2+ chars; e.g. 'a.b.com' or 'example.x' wrongly rejected.
Subsequent labels limited to 1 or 3 chars; 'example.io', 'example.co.uk' rejected.
